title: P-GenRM: Personalized Generative Reward Model with Test-time User-based Scaling
reasoning: The paper focuses on the development and evaluation of a Personalized Generative Reward Model (P-GenRM) for LLM alignment. While it utilizes datasets like PRISM that involve subjective human values and evaluates model performance on ethical topics (e.g., 'moral responsibility' in Figure 7), its primary focus is on the reward model's architecture and scaling mechanisms rather than the specific study or benchmarking of religion, faith, or ethical frameworks.
